text:
nina: Quick check-in after the weekend outage — batch reindex caused sustained p95 blowouts on inference-route-2. Need owners for remediation tasks + SLO decision by EOD.

ark: Confirmed. Pattern: long-tail requests during concurrent reindex + small interactive queries. p95 baseline ~85ms -> sustained ~520ms for ~18min. Burned ~1.1% error budget on that route.

tyler: I can pick up the routing + QoS changes. Suggest: create a low-priority batch queue and mark it for non-interactive SLO. Prototype in a branch this week.

nina: Good. Who can do SLO proposal doc (options + rollback + metric queries)? We need to show Product + SRE leads.

ark: I'll draft the SLO proposal. Two options: keep single SLO and tighten autoscale (higher infra), or split: interactive p95 <= 110ms, batch p95 <= 450ms. I'll include cost delta table and simulation charts.

tyler: For routing, I propose the rule: if inflight_batch_jobs > 5 OR batch-queue-depth > 100 then route to batch-pool. Also add soft-throttle to experiments. Will add a runbook section.

alerts-bot: Current alert: inference-route-2_p95 > 200ms over 5m. New suggested alerts: inference-route-2_batch_p95 > 350ms over 5m, interact_p95 > 150ms over 2m, error-budget-burn > 0.5%/day.

nina: Assignments then:
- ark: SLO proposal doc + incident timeline + historical recurrence table (deliverable: doc + slides) 15 2026-03-28
- tyler: routing prototype + runbook PR + canary plan 15 2026-04-05
- nina: postmortem update, product notification draft, and stakeholder sync 15 2026-03-26

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood/postmortems/2026-03-batch-reindex-inference 15 owner @nina

ark: I'll also add a recurrence table showing related incidents: 2025-11-11, 2026-01-15, 2026-03-21. Pattern looks tied to monthly backfills + simultaneous deploys.

tyler: One quick win: add the route label "workload_type" to metrics so dashboards can split interactive vs batch; I'll add that change to the SDK patch.

nina: Product may not accept automatic throttles that degrade user-facing results without a human in loop. Proposal: automated throttles for non-customer-impacting experiments only; manual intervention for user-facing. I'll run this by @product-lead after ark's cost numbers.

ark: Draft SLO snippet I'll include:
```
interactive: p95 <= 110ms
batch: p95 <= 450ms
pb: error_budget_burn > 0.5%/day -> trigger review
```

alerts-bot: Canary plan: tag canary routing as canaries/model-batch-routing/v1, traffic ramp 1% -> 10% over 4h.

tyler: Ops note: expected infra delta for separate batch pool ~+9% monthly. If we opt to keep single pool and increase capacity, delta ~+22%. I'll validate with cost team during prototype.

nina: Scheduling weekly follow-up: Wednesdays 09:30 PT until 2 weeks w/o recurrence. Invites to ark/tyler/cost-eng/product-lead.

ark: Putting RCA timeline and trace links here when ready. Will include flamegraphs + KV pressure charts.

tyler: I'll open branch + PR and post link here when canary plan is ready.

nina: Keep this thread for links only please. Mark when deliverables land so I can update the postmortem checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly SLO sync 2026-03-25 16:30 UTC (recurring).

tyler: ack :thumbsup: starting work today.

ark: ack.

nina: thanks all.
